name: sure.co.fk
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.sure.co.fk scores 74 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 89 elements on /, /our-shop/, /our-shop/mobile-phones/, for example h1. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 18 elements on /, /our-shop/, /our-shop/mobile-phones/, for example .col-sm-3.hidden-xs:nth-child(1) > ul > li:nth-child(2) > a[href$="our-footprint/"][title="Our Footprint"] and .col-sm-3.hidden-xs:nth-child(1) > ul > li:nth-child(3) >…
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /our-shop/, /our-shop/mobile-phones/, for example .active.item > a[href$="broadband-packages/"] and a[alt="Facebook"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 15 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /our-shop/home-phones-and-business-equipment/, /our-shop/modems-and-extenders/, /our-shop/games-and-consoles/, /our-shop/streaming-devices-and-media-players/ and 11 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
The sitemap matches the pages that were analyzed
